name: fuse
description: Fuse — circuit breaker for autonomous AI agents (hackathon prototype)

scripts.engine-check: node -e "const M=process.versions.node.split('.')[0]; if(M!=='22'){console.warn('Fuse targets Node.js 22.x; current is '+process.versions.node+'. Do not use Node 24-only APIs.'); process.exitCode=0;}"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p infra/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.json --noEmit
